description: a unique blade made of zirconium oxide, an advanced material that its hardness just less than the diamond. THIS SPECIAL BLADE will hold its edge much longer than steel, will never rust and won’t alter the look or taste of food. EASY CLEAN BY HAND, NO DISHWASHER.The knife is nonmagnetic completely. MADE OF compacted material and has ergonomic plastic handle , ergonomically shaped handle (ABS) in black which keep the ceramic knife lightweight and colorful, added TPR on handle feels much more comfortable while holding.

It is ideal for straight cuts of fruits, vegetables and boneless meats.It always use with a plastic or wood cutting board. Avoid cutting on marble, stone, glass, or tile.Use your conventional steel knives for carving, prying, boning, and cutting frozen food and cheese. These applications involve twisting and flexing, which require a more flexible material than ceramic. Hand wash with water and liquid dish soap; do not wash in the dishwasher. For discolorations not removed by normal washing, wash the blade only with a mild bleach solution
